label: FP
reason: Both alerts are false positives. Alert 1 (XSS): The sink at L91-L92 encodes bar via encodeForHTML(), but bar resolves to "moresafe" (a constant) after valuesList.remove(0) shifts indices—original index 2 becomes index 1, so get(1) returns "moresafe", not user input. Alert 2 (SQL injection): The sink at L67 uses bar in SQL string, but bar resolves to "moresafe" (constant) on the executed path—not attacker-controlled. Both sinks receive a hardcoded literal, making them structurally false positives.
